metadata.description: Mailcall: an agent that reads your mailbox - a morning summary, who waits for your answer, and your Google Alerts turned into a short digest. Read-only, drafts only, no passwords in files.

plugins.name: mailcall
plugins.description: Morning mail summary, people waiting for your answer, and Google Alerts / newsletters digested by the words you watch. Gmail connector of your Claude subscription, or read-only IMAP with an app password kept in the system keychain. Drafts only - nothing is sent without your yes.
